outline: 介紹含碳化合物的命名、結構與性質的基本概念。課程重點在反應機構、合成、立體化學、化學分析及儀器分析方法。
schedule:
週次/單元主題
1/課程介紹
2~3/Chapter 1. Structure and Bonding; Acids and Bases
4~5/Chapter 2. Alkanes: The Nature of Organic Molecules
5/第一次測驗
5~6/Chapter 3. The Nature of Organic Reactions: Alkenes
7~8/Chapter 4. Reactions of Alkenes and Alkynes
9/第二次測驗（期中考）
10~11/Chapter 5. Aromatic Compounds
11~12/Chapter 6. Stereochemistry
13/第三次測驗
13~14/Chapter 7. Organichalides: Nucleophilic Substitutions and Eliminations
14~15/Chapter 8. Alcohols, Phenols, Ethers, and Their Sulfur Analogs
16~17/Chapter 9. Aldehydes and Ketones: Nucleophilic Addition Reactions
18/第四次測驗（期末考）
assessment: 出缺勤、學習態度、四次測驗（含期中考及期末考）
